SELECT e.event_id,e.attempt_id,e.tenant_id,e.session_id,e.run_id,e.root_input_id, e.cost_status,e.confirmed_cost_cents FROM billing_effective_usage e WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.event_type<>'request'
AND (
(e.session_id=#{scope.sessionId} AND e.run_id=#{scope.runId} AND e.root_input_id=#{scope.rootInputId})
)
AND FALSE
ORDER BY e.occurred_at,e.id

mapper.sql: SELECT MAX(report_revision) AS report_revision, (array_agg(prompt_tokens ORDER BY COALESCE(report_revision,usage_snapshot_revision,-1) DESC,id DESC) FILTER(WHERE prompt_tokens IS NOT NULL AND usage_source='PROVIDER_REPORTED'))[1] AS prompt_tokens, (array_agg(completion_tokens ORDER BY COALESCE(report_revision,usage_snapshot_revision,-1) DESC,id DESC) FILTER(WHERE completion_tokens IS NOT NULL AND usage_source='PROVIDER_REPORTED'))[1] AS completion_tokens, (array_agg(cached_input_tokens ORDER BY COALESCE(report_revision,usage_snapshot_revision,-1) DESC,id DESC) FILTER(WHERE cached_input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND usage_source='PROVIDER_REPORTED'))[1] AS cached_input_tokens, (array_agg(cache_write_input_tokens ORDER BY COALESCE(report_revision,usage_snapshot_revision,-1) DESC,id DESC) FILTER(WHERE cache_write_input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND usage_source='PROVIDER_REPORTED'))[1] AS cache_write_input_tokens, (array_agg(reasoning_output_tokens ORDER BY COALESCE(report_revision,usage_snapshot_revision,-1) DESC,id DESC) FILTER(WHERE reasoning_output_tokens IS NOT NULL AND usage_source='PROVIDER_REPORTED'))[1] AS reasoning_output_tokens

mapper.select: SELECT a.calls,a.tokens,a.prompt_tokens,a.completion_tokens,a.total_amount_cents,a.confirmed_cost, a.missing_cost_count+i.missing AS missing_cost_count, CASE WHEN a.missing_cost_count+i.missing>0 THEN 'unresolved' ELSE 'recorded' END AS usage_status FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE event_type='request') AS calls, FROM billing_effective_usage WHERE ) a CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS missing FROM nw_external_invocations e WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.started_at>=#{from} AND e.started_at<(((#{from}::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') + interval '1 month') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_usage_events u WHERE u.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND u.attempt_id=e.attempt_id AND u.usage_event_kind='measured')) i

SELECT event_type,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT(event_type IN ('media.image','media.video','media.transcription','media.speech') AND quantity=0 AND amount_status='not_applicable')) AS quantity, FROM billing_effective_usage WHERE GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY event_type

SELECT COALESCE(agent_id::text,'-')COALESCE(end_user_id::text,'-')COALESCE(channel_id,'-')COALESCE(model,'-')event_type AS dimension, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE event_type='request') AS calls, FROM billing_effective_usage WHERE GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY tokens DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE event_type LIKE 'llm.%') AS calls, FROM billing_effective_usage WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND (request_id=#{requestId} OR root_input_id=#{requestId})

WITH requests(request_id) AS (VALUES (#{id}::text)) SELECT q.request_id,a.calls,a.tokens,a.prompt_tokens,a.completion_tokens,a.total_amount_cents,a.confirmed_cost, a.missing_cost_count+i.missing AS missing_cost_count, CASE WHEN i.running>0 THEN 'running' WHEN i.failed>0 THEN 'failed' WHEN i.missing+a.missing_cost_count>0 THEN 'unresolved' WHEN a.calls=0 THEN 'pending_or_no_usage' ELSE 'recorded' END AS usage_status FROM requests q CROSS JOIN LATERAL( SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE event_type LIKE 'llm.%') AS calls, FROM billing_effective_usage WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND (request_id=q.request_id OR root_input_id=q.request_id)) a CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE i.status='STARTED') AS running, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE i.status='FAILED') AS failed, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_usage_events u WHERE u.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND u.attempt_id=i.attempt_id AND u.usage_event_kind='measured')) AS missing FROM nw_external_invocations i WHERE i.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND (i.input_id=q.request_id OR i.root_input_id=q.request_id)) i
